evals.prompt: Review this React page component 'src/pages/VM/pages/assessments-list.jsx'. It uses RTK Query to load assessments, displays tabs for All/Active/Archived, and renders a table. Audit the component according to our frontend design standards and point out any violations.
evals.expected_output: The agent generates a standalone markdown review file (e.g. FRONTEND_REVIEW_assessments-list.md) detailing every issue with file, line number, issue description, and exact proposed code fix (covering ApiErrorHandler, iconless TabsTrigger, table cell '-' fallbacks, primary action button, and EmptyScreen). The agent links to the report in chat and prompts the user to decide how to proceed with fixes.

evals.prompt: Conduct a frontend code review on our new Cloud Dashboard component at 'src/pages/auto-pt/cloud-security/dashboard.jsx'. The component shows several vulnerability distribution charts, stats cards, and a loading state.
evals.expected_output: The agent writes a markdown review file documenting issues by file and line with proposed fixes: flags charts lacking header info icons with hover tooltips, verifies layout-reflecting Skeletons over generic spinners, checks ApiErrorHandler and empty screen fallbacks, and awaits user decision before modifying code.

evals.prompt: Please review this new modal form component 'src/pages/AIM/components/CreatePolicyModal.jsx'. Check its form validation, field labels, action buttons, and overall UI compliance.
evals.expected_output: The agent generates a markdown review report outlining issues (file, line, description, and exact fix): verifies Zod schema in schema.jsx, React Hook Form usage, input placeholders, iconless FormLabels, primary submit button with icon and disabled states, and waits for user decision on fixing.

evals.prompt: Review the directory structure and implementation of our new feature page 'src/pages/AIM/pages/integrations/'. Currently everything is crammed into a single monolithic 800-line integrations.jsx file, with inline form states and prop-drilling.
evals.expected_output: The agent produces a markdown review report detailing architectural violations by file and line with a refactoring blueprint: prescribes page-name/, store.js (Zustand), page-name.jsx (lean composer with ApiErrorHandler and EmptyScreen), components/forms/ (form1.jsx and schema.jsx), and per-component isLoading skeleton contracts. The agent awaits user approval before modifying files.
